title: Vector
formulas: Resultant of two vectors: $R = \sqrt{A^2 + B^2 + 2AB\cos\theta}$, with $\tan\alpha = \frac{B\sin\theta}{A + B\cos\theta}$.
Scalar (dot) product: $\vec{A}\cdot\vec{B} = AB\cos\theta$; vector (cross) product: $|\vec{A}\times\vec{B}| = AB\sin\theta$.
Unit vector and resolution: $\hat{A} = \vec{A}/|A|$, $A_x = A\cos\theta$, $A_y = A\sin\theta$, $A = \sqrt{A_x^2 + A_y^2}$.
keyPoints: Dot product is maximum at θ = 0° and zero at 90°; the cross product is the reverse — that pairing is the fastest way to pick the right operator.
summary: Vector covers essential principles and applications.
examNotes: Focus on Vector problems - significant marks.
